name: What are common signs I need plumbing repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs I need plumbing repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs include reduced water pressure, unusual noises from pipes or water heaters, foul odors from drains, slow drainage, or visible water stains and leaks. Even minor drips can indicate a larger issue and should be addressed promptly to prevent further damage. Discolored water or a sudden increase in your water bill without a change in usage also suggest a problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reduced water pressure, strange noises, foul odors, slow drains, or visible leaks are common signs you need plumbing repair.
